faq.intro: Quick answers about VPN privacy, connections, devices, and Traverse plans.

items.question: What does a VPN do?
items.answer: A VPN creates an encrypted connection between your device and a VPN server. It can help protect your traffic on shared networks and mask your IP address from the sites you visit.

items.question: Can I use Traverse on public Wi-Fi?
items.answer: Yes. A VPN can add encryption when you connect through shared Wi-Fi in places such as cafés, hotels, and airports. Keep your device and apps updated as well.

items.question: Which devices can I use?
items.answer: Traverse VPN supports the devices and platforms listed on its official website and app listings. Check those listings for current compatibility and setup instructions.

items.question: Does Traverse VPN keep activity logs?
items.answer: Traverse describes its service as no-logs. Review the current privacy policy for details about what data is collected to operate the service.

items.question: How much does Traverse VPN cost?
items.answer: Plans include weekly, monthly, and annual options. The current listed prices are $1.49 per week, $3.99 per month, or $1.99 per month with annual billing; confirm the price in the official checkout before subscribing.
